standardized_threshold_scope: pooled common-valid reference-upland pixels across all test cores in a fit
validation_threshold_scope: pooled common-valid reference-upland pixels across validation cores in a fit
primary_recovery: at least 50 percent of a mapped patch's valid center pixels positive
primary_aggregation: unweighted mean of regional small-patch recovery; publish each regional count and any undefined stratum
oracle_object_training_frame: training-area components sharing an original source polygon are grouped; no evaluation-geography object identity enters selection
feature_matrix_storage: regenerable cache excluded from Git; feature hashes and bundled small reference arrays retained; raw clipped inputs and saved probabilities remain tracked
